repPj.label: rep pj
repPj.tooltip: Setting the rep query param to pj will create a plain JSON response without any metadata. This removes any information about the number of elements or pages in the response and therefore breaks the pagination.

count.label: count
count.tooltip: Adds metadata to the response containing information about the number of elements and pages. Needed for pagination to work correctly, but slows down the request.
